# Contacts and groups

Store contacts and contact groups, and send a message to a whole group. API keys need the `contacts:manage` scope. For developers syncing an address book into OpenSMS.

Back to the [API reference index](README.md). Shared shapes are in [Schemas](schemas.md); conventions (auth headers, errors, pagination, idempotency) are in the [index](README.md#conventions).

| Method | Path | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | [`/v1/contacts`](#get-v1contacts) | GET contacts |
| POST | [`/v1/contacts`](#post-v1contacts) | POST contacts |
| GET | [`/v1/contacts/{id}`](#get-v1contactsid) | GET contacts |
| PATCH | [`/v1/contacts/{id}`](#patch-v1contactsid) | PATCH contacts |
| DELETE | [`/v1/contacts/{id}`](#delete-v1contactsid) | DELETE contacts |
| GET | [`/v1/contact-groups`](#get-v1contact-groups) | GET contact-groups |
| POST | [`/v1/contact-groups`](#post-v1contact-groups) | POST contact-groups |
| GET | [`/v1/contact-groups/{id}`](#get-v1contact-groupsid) | GET contact-groups |
| PATCH | [`/v1/contact-groups/{id}`](#patch-v1contact-groupsid) | PATCH contact-groups |
| DELETE | [`/v1/contact-groups/{id}`](#delete-v1contact-groupsid) | DELETE contact-groups |
| POST | [`/v1/contact-groups/{id}/send`](#post-v1contact-groupsidsend) | Snapshot a contact group and admit its messages as a batch |

## GET /v1/contacts

**GET contacts**

Operation ID: `getContactCollection`. Tag: _none in contract_.

See docs/contacts-api.md. Session requires X-Workspace-ID and X-Environment; API keys require contacts:manage. Lists return items and next_cursor.

**Auth:** Session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`), or API key with scope `contacts:manage`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Workspace-ID` | header | string (uuid) | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. Must identify an undeleted workspace where the active user is a member. API keys use their own workspace and ignore this header. |
| `X-Environment` | header | string | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. API keys use their own environment and ignore this header. One of: `sandbox`, `live`. |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | `50` | Constraints: minimum `1`, maximum `200`. |
| `cursor` | query | string | no |  | Opaque cursor returned by the previous page for this collection and workspace. Constraints: maxLength `2048`. |

**Request body:** none.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Success. | `application/json`: see fields below |
| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `401` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `403` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `404` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `409` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `422` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `503` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

Response `200` fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array of object | yes |  |  |
| `items[].id` | string (uuid) | no |  |  |
| `items[].workspace_id` | string (uuid) | no |  |  |
| `items[].e164` | string | no |  |  |
| `items[].name` | string \| null | no |  | Constraints: maxLength `200`. |
| `items[].attributes` | object | no |  |  |
| `items[].created_at` | string (date-time) | no |  |  |
| `next_cursor` | string \| null | yes |  |  |

**Example**

<!-- tabs label="Request example" -->
```bash tab="cURL"
curl -s -X GET "$OPENSMS_API/v1/contacts" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_test_VG0...'
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const opensms = new Opensms({ apiKey: process.env.OPENSMS_API_KEY! });

const page = await opensms.contacts.list();

for (const item of page.items) {
  console.log(item.id, item.e164);
}
```

```python tab="Python"
client = Opensms(api_key=os.environ["OPENSMS_API_KEY"])

page = client.contacts.list()

for item in page.items:
    print(item["id"], item["e164"])
```

```go tab="Go"
client, err := opensms.NewClient(os.Getenv("OPENSMS_API_KEY"))
if err != nil {
	log.Fatal(err)
}
ctx := context.Background()

page, err := client.Contacts.List(ctx, opensms.ListParams{})
if err != nil {
	log.Fatal(err)
}
for _, item := range page.Items {
	fmt.Println(item.ID, item.E164)
}
```

```php tab="PHP"
$opensms = new Client(getenv('OPENSMS_API_KEY'));

$page = $opensms->contacts->list();

foreach ($page->items as $item) {
    echo $item['id'], ' ', $item['e164'], PHP_EOL;
}
```

```java tab="Java"
OpensmsClient opensms = new OpensmsClient(System.getenv("OPENSMS_API_KEY"));

var page = opensms.contacts().list();

for (var item : page.items) {
    System.out.println(item.id + " " + item.e164);
}
```

```csharp tab="C#"
using var client = new OpensmsClient(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("OPENSMS_API_KEY")!);

var page = await client.Contacts.ListAsync();

foreach (var item in page.Items)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"{item.Id} {item.E164}");
}
```

```ruby tab="Ruby"
client = Opensms::Client.new(api_key: ENV.fetch("OPENSMS_API_KEY"))

page = client.contacts.list()

page.items.each do |item|
  puts "#{item[:id]} #{item[:e164]}"
end
```

```rust tab="Rust"
let client = Client::new(std::env::var("OPENSMS_API_KEY").unwrap())?;

let page = client.contacts().list(ListParams::default()).await?;

for item in &page.items {
    println!("{} {}", item.id, item.e164.as_deref().unwrap_or_default());
}
```

```swift tab="Swift"
let apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["OPENSMS_API_KEY"] ?? ""
let opensms = try OpensmsClient(apiKey: apiKey)

let page = try await opensms.contacts.list()

for item in page.items {
    print(item.id, item.e164 ?? "")
}
```



```go tab="Go"
client, err := opensms.NewClient(os.Getenv("OPENSMS_API_KEY"))
```


```java tab="Java"
OpensmsClient opensms = new OpensmsClient(System.getenv("OPENSMS_API_KEY"));
```

```csharp tab="C#"
using var client = new OpensmsClient(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("OPENSMS_API_KEY")!);
```

```ruby tab="Ruby"
client = Opensms::Client.new(api_key: ENV.fetch("OPENSMS_API_KEY"))

contact = client.contacts.create(

)

```

```rust tab="Rust"
let client = Client::new(std::env::var("OPENSMS_API_KEY").unwrap())?;

    .contacts()

        name: Some("Amina W.".into()),
        attributes: Some(serde_json::json!({ "tier": "gold" })),
    })
    .await?;

println!("{} {}", contact.id, contact.e164.as_deref().unwrap_or_default());
```


## POST /v1/contact-groups/{id}/send

**Snapshot a contact group and admit its messages as a batch**

Operation ID: `postContactGroupSend`. Tag: _none in contract_.

Requires contacts:manage and messages:write for API keys; template_id additionally requires templates:manage. Browser sessions require owner/admin/developer membership. Replays retain original recipients and rendered content. See docs/contacts-api.md. Template IDs additionally require templates:manage for API keys. Contact snapshot is durable; shared batch admission records individual rejection results. Same-key retries reuse the original snapshot.

**Auth:** Session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`), or API key with scope `contacts:manage` and `messages:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |  |
| `X-Workspace-ID` | header | string (uuid) | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. Must identify an undeleted workspace where the active user is a member. API keys use their own workspace and ignore this header. |
| `X-Environment` | header | string | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. API keys use their own environment and ignore this header. One of: `sandbox`, `live`. |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | string | yes |  | Constraints: minLength `1`, maxLength `200`. |

**Request body** (`application/json`, required)

One of:

Alternative 1: Type: any. Constraints: not `{"required":["template_id"]}`.

Alternative 2: Type: any. Constraints: not `{"required":["text"]}`.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Success. | `application/json`: [Batch](schemas.md#batch) |
| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `401` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `403` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `404` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `409` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `422` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `503` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

**Example**

```bash tab="cURL"
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: docs-ddfac12d-7fc0-4a7b-8b2a-b3dad169a382' \
```

Response `200` (`application/json`):

```json
{
  "id": "85a60588-a781-49c1-8e4a-71230e1eab9a",
  "status": "failed",
  "total": 1,
  "sent": 0,
  "delivered": 0,
  "failed": 0,
  "invalid": 1,
  "duplicates": 0,
  "suppressed": 0,
  "estimated_cost": 0,
  "created_at": "2026-09-24T07:40:23.379409+03:00"
}
```

The group send is accepted as a batch. Here the workspace owner had not verified their email yet, so every recipient was refused at admission and the batch is `failed` with all rows invalid.
